# Who sits where? Let the search sort your seating chart.

> Free seating chart optimizer for weddings, banquets and events. Paste your guest list, say who sits together and who must be kept apart, and it assigns every guest to a table with the most wishes met. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
